title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): Support for new ExtendedDataType value: Document (display/preview a PDF as a portrait image in FactBox)
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 2 introduces a new ExtendedDataType value called Document for Media and MediaSet fields, enabling portrait-oriented content like PDFs to be displayed in FactBoxes on ListPart and CardPart pages. The feature requires image conversion and currently supports only the first page of multi-page PDFs due to a bug.
key_points: Document ExtendedDataType value supports Media and MediaSet fields on ListPart and CardPart page types only
PDFs must be converted to images before storage, using codeunit 3110 PDF Document for conversion
Current limitation restricts display to the first page of multi-page PDFs (bug under Microsoft review)
Media data type provides better performance than BLOB for caching and rendering in the UI

quotes.text: Using the Media or MediaSet data type provides better performance than using a BLOB data type and is more flexible in its design
quotes.why_it_matters: Justifies when to use Media over BLOB for storing and displaying content
